hints.title: Duplicate Point Detection
hints.text: If any two points have identical coordinates, their Manhattan distance is 0, which is the absolute theoretical minimum.

hints.title: Divide and Conquer Metric Separation
hints.text: Sort the points by x-coordinate and recursively compute the closest pair on the left and right halves.

hints.title: Boundary Strip Verification
hints.text: Filter points within horizontal distance d of the dividing line, sort them by y-coordinate, and check adjacent candidates within vertical distance d.

hints.title: Divide and Conquer Closest Pair Implementation

complexity.notes: Divide and conquer closest pair adapted for Manhattan metric.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all pairs takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space for sorted coordinate arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies closest pair of points divide and conquer with Manhattan metric.
